info.title: expense.io — delivered HTTP contract
info.description: LE-10 / ARLA-28. Baseline main 61d2404 (HA-02 merged), 22 October 2026. Current behavior only; approved product target and pending transitions are in README.md. Auth.js actions are delegated. This document does not claim RLS, atomic decisions, idempotency, pagination or async OCR.

servers.description: Same origin as the application; no production hostname or credentials.

get.summary: Current active session; own notes, all statuses. No pagination.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Legacy SQL sort fragment; only send created_at DESC. No allowlist or rejected-invalid-sort guarantee before LE-01. Never forward untrusted sort input.

post.summary: Submit own note, pending; no atomic storage guarantee or idempotency contract yet.

amount.description: Send positive decimal text with at most two fractional digits. Legacy parseFloat accepts more than this convention.

expenseDate.description: Send a real YYYY-MM-DD date; strict HTTP validation pending LE-01.

receipt.description: Declared PNG/JPEG/WebP/PDF, at most 10 MiB. Legacy checks MIME and size, not file structure or empty content.

post.summary: Synchronous French OCR, optional fields only. Unsupported MIME, OCR failure or ambiguity can return 200 {}. PDF is not OCR-supported. No request size limit in this route yet.

get.summary: Current active owner, including after a decision. Empty/blank key and invisible/missing note return 404.

sessionCookie.name: authjs.session-token
sessionCookie.description: Opaque JWT session from Auth.js credentials flow on local HTTP. Current rights reloaded on every request.

secureSessionCookie.name: __Secure-authjs.session-token
secureSessionCookie.description: HTTPS secure-cookie variant. Chunked cookies are managed by Auth.js. Never send as Bearer authorization.

receiptKey.description: Opaque storage key, not a URL. May be empty in existing partial submissions (LE-02 pending).

url.description: Presigned GET, default expiry 300 seconds. Signing does not verify object existence; treat as a secret.
